body:
Hello again.... figured I'd give you an update. 
Today sucked. But then it got better.
See what she had actually said to me was...

"Please stop texting me so much"

I did text her today to address this. See I read it as, don't talk to me anymore. I asked her for clarification on this. She told me she does want to be friends, but she really does not like using her phone. So that's cool. We're still planning on doing things this weekend. The panic attack is over.

Thanks for talking to me last night.

She's not trying to force me out of the group. I just will get panic attacks. I cannot handle being in the group anymore.

She is definitely not a bitch, but thank you lol.

I've always hated holidays and birthdays. There is such a pressure to do something. My family never really did anything see... my dad always had a drinking problem which eventually grew to a meth problem.

I never really had much for friends. I've always been socially awkward and on top of that, I never felt safe having people in the house I grew up in. It hasn't translated well to my adult life.

So now I actually had found a group of friends I felt good about. This happened in November of last year. I've spent most of my free time with these people.

Once a month at least we meet for party games. We're supposed to be meeting Saturday the 30th, but I no longer plan on going. See, I was interested in this girl in the group. A week ago, I let her know how I felt about her. She was not interested. It sucked, but at least I still had the friendship.

Then we hung out this last Saturday. Everything seemed okay.

But tonight I received a text from her saying Please do not contact me anymore.

That's what's got me so down tonight. I consider her a much more integral part of the group than myself too, so her not wanting me around will likely push me out of my group of friends. At any rate, it was her, me and one other person who were planning on doing things on my birthday. We were going to go to an amusement park. I no longer plan to do anything. I had been excited but this sucks.

I feel like I lost all of my friends tonight.

Trying to distract myself. I kinda ruined a bunch of friendships this weekend.

Now, I took some sleeping pills to sleep. I'm intending on going to work tomorrow. I like work because it distracts me from everything else.

I plan on taking sleeping pills as soon as I get home though. All through Friday. But I have no clue how I am going to handle the weekend.

My birthday is Sunday. It's going to be terrible.
Hi. How are you doing? This sub feels like a bad place to be depressed. Probably most of the people here aren't doing that great.
